entities.name: Michał Piaszczyński
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Michael Piaszczynski was a Polish Catholic priest who was arrested by the Nazis and killed at Sachsenhausen concentration camp. As a martyr he was beatified by Pope John Paul II on 13 June 1999.
